keystone_default_deployment_name.description: Logical name for this deployment; used in logs and to disambiguate multi-tenancy.

keystone_assignment_driver.description: Backend driver for managing role/project/user assignments.

keystone_auth_methods.description: Supported authentication methods for clients (e.g., password, token, oauth1).

keystone_catalog_driver.description: Backend driver for service catalog (list of endpoints per service).

keystone_credential_driver.description: Storage backend for credentials (e.g., fernet for encrypted key rotation).

keystone_database_connection.description: Database connection URI. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite (for dev).

keystone_federation_driver.description: Backend for federated identity (SAML, OpenID Connect, etc.).

keystone_fernet_tokens_key_repository.description: Path to directory storing Fernet token keys. Must be writable and synced across nodes.

keystone_ldap_url.description: LDAP server URL (required only if using LDAP backend).

keystone_memcache_servers.description: List of memcached servers for caching (e.g., ['host1:11211', 'host2:11211']).

keystone_paste_deploy_config.description: PasteDeploy config path defining WSGI pipeline and middleware.

keystone_resource_driver.description: Backend driver for managing projects and domains.

keystone_signing_certfile.description: Path to PKI signing certificate (legacy PKI tokens only).

keystone_signing_keyfile.description: Path to PKI signing private key (legacy PKI tokens only).

keystone_token_expiration.description: Token lifetime in seconds. Shorter = more secure, more overhead.

keystone_token_max_concurrent.description: Max simultaneous active tokens per user.

keystone_token_revocation_driver.description: Backend for token revocation list (e.g., sql, redis, memcache).

keystone_token_cache_driver.description: Backend for caching token metadata (e.g., sql, memcache).

keystone_token_use_cache.description: Enable caching of token lookups for improved performance.

keystone_token_expire_on_revocation.description: Immediately expire revoked tokens (requires driver support).

keystone_token_pki_revocation_cache.description: Enable PKI revocation cache (legacy PKI tokens only).

keystone_tokenless_auth_driver.description: Backend for tokenless auth flows (e.g., OAuth1).

keystone_endpoint_policy_driver.description: Backend for endpoint access control policies.

keystone_eventlet_server_bind_host.description: Network interface for public API server (v2/v3).

keystone_eventlet_server_admin_port.description: Port for admin-only API endpoints (e.g., user management).

keystone_eventlet_server_workers.description: Number of worker processes for handling requests.

keystone_eventlet_server_enable_ssl.description: Enable HTTPS for the API endpoints.

keystone_eventlet_server_ssl_certfile.description: Path to SSL certificate file (required if SSL is enabled).

keystone_eventlet_server_ssl_keyfile.description: Path to SSL private key file (required if SSL is enabled).

keystone_eventlet_server_ssl_ca_certs.description: Path to CA bundle for client certificate verification (mTLS).

keystone_eventlet_server_max_request_bod.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of request body allowed (DOCS: default ~112 KiB).

keystone_redis_url.description: Redis connection URL for token storage or caching (e.g., 'redis://redis:6379').
